words.tr: phrase. 促进文化传播与融合

words.en: Strengthen the sense of duty and participation in civic duties among citizens.

words.tr: phrase. 促进创新和创造力

words.ex_cn: 这所学校帮助培养学生的创新和创造力。
words.en: Encourage the generation and application of new ideas and inventive solutions.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解就业压力

words.tr: phrase. 提高国家生产力；提升国民生产率

words.ex_cn: 他忽视了实践技能的培养。

words.tr: phrase. 加剧社会分层；使社会阶层分化更加严重

words.ex_cn: 学费上涨增加了家庭的经济负担。
words.en: To add to the financial strain experienced by households, often due to rising costs.

words.ex: Too many rules can stifle creative thinking.
words.ex_cn: 太多的规则会抑制创造性思维。
words.en: To suppress or prevent the generation of original and imaginative ideas.

words.ex: The prize system triggers excessive competition among students.
words.ex_cn: 奖励制度引发了学生之间的过度竞争。

words.ex_cn: 太多作业会影响学生的身心健康。
words.en: To have a detrimental effect on the well-being of students, encompassing both bodily and emotional states.

words.tr: phrase. 教育资源分配不均的；形容教育机会、设施或师资等在地区或群体间分布不平衡的情况

words.ex_cn: 教育资源分配不均影响了农村学校。
words.en: When educational opportunities, funding, or facilities are not shared equally among different groups or regions.

words.tr: phrase. 过度依赖标准化测试
words.ex: There is overreliance on standardized testing in this school.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过度依赖标准化测试。

words.en: Unequal distribution of resources and focus in educational systems.

words.tr: phrase. 推动社会进步

words.tr: phrase. 支持远程工作和学习

words.en: To facilitate work and study from locations other than a traditional office or classroom.

words.tr: phrase. 促进科学研究
